name: View options: colliders, markers, wireframe, hidden and locked entities
body:
# View options

View menu toggles: show colliders (kinematic in a second colour), show markers, show the selection as wireframe only,
show entity names as labels at their origins (needs text in the 3D view: drawn by the UI layer over the viewport from
projected positions exposed through the C API). Per-entity hide and lock, set from the outliner's eye and padlock
icons: a hidden entity is not drawn or picked, a locked one is drawn but never picked or moved. Hide and lock are
editor state saved beside the world (see the question).

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27. View options grid, wireframe, colliders, markers, level bounds, hidden entities and stats, as toolbar toggles, View menu checks and Settings > Viewport checkboxes; locked entities are drawn but not pickable.

questions.text: Where should editor-only per-entity state (hidden, locked, expanded in the outliner) live: in the world file as an `editor` block the game ignores, in a sidecar `<world>.editor.json`, or only in memory for the session?
questions.recommendation: A: A sidecar <name>.editor.json beside the world file, so the world file stays exactly what the game loads and the state still survives a restart.
